prompt.objetivo: Build or correct the product from current artifacts and the existing code. This phase does not redesign earlier phases.

alcance.opcion: The increment or story the user names.
The current backlog, sequenced by dependencies. Not every story in one change.
A fix or a targeted correction. Reproduce, correct, and verify only that behavior. Use templates/targeted-fix/ when the request is a local correction.

hacer.paso: The functional source is current/backlog/, or current/extendido/backlog-extendido.csv when it exists. Do not implement from the preliminary.
Load policies, engineering-standards, and design-system for the layer being touched. The user-story workflow keeps its routing and its adaptive complexity.
Write code, tests, and the minimum documentation for the change. Update the four incremental documents when the change justifies it.
The report says what was verified and what was not. A test that was not run is not listed as passing.
Commits follow git-workflow.xml and formats/delivery/COMMIT_CONVENTIONS.md, only when the user asked for version control. A push requires explicit authorization.

bloqueo.regla: If the story depends on another story that is not implemented, implement the dependency first or stop and say so.
If the current SAD and the code disagree, do not "fix" the architecture in silence. Record the divergence and ask, unless the request is precisely that correction.
